_comment: Field selection for the gnomAD exome/genome callsets (VEP parquet).
INCLUDE-list: 'load': true is what reaches the parquet.
Generated from the v4.1.1 chr21 header; the 46 VEP subfields are
identical between exomes and genomes, verified on chr21.
One output row per (variant x transcript x consequence): the VEP
block is exploded, not stored as the packed string gnomAD ships.
Order used when a variant carries VEP in both callsets. Measured on
chr21: only 1.9% of variants are in both, and their VEP blocks are
byte-identical in 5781/5782 cases — the single exception differs
only in the order of terms inside Consequence, which disappears
once the block is exploded. So this is a deterministic tie-break,
not a content decision.

explode._comment: Split multi-term Consequence on '&', one row per term.

_comment: Applied per callset against that callset's own AC, so this DTP
stays independent of the joint branch (ADR-003: the two data
sources must not depend on each other).
Measured on chr21, window pos<=7,261,905, with min_ac 5 on both
sides: VEP unfiltered is 300,000 keys against the joint's 45,702
(6.6x more annotation than the bundle can use); filtering here
yields 45,478 with ZERO rows orphaned from the joint output.
Cost: 224 joint variants (0.5%) clear the combined AC but not
either callset alone, so they land in the variants parquet with
no annotation. Set min_ac to null to keep them, at 6.6x the size.
Keep min_ac aligned with the joint config.
Side output: chromosome/position/ref/alt -> rsID, written as its
own table rather than stamped onto variant_masters.
The joint callset carries no rsID at all (its ID column is empty
on every record); only the exome and genome VCFs do, which is why
this is produced here.
IMPORTANT: rows are captured BEFORE the AC filter above. Measured
on chr21, only ~25% of rsIDs survive AC>=5, and the ones dropped
are the rare variants that most need an identifier.
min_ac tunes how much of the map is kept:
null -> every rsID gnomAD publishes (chr21: 9.85 M keys,
75 MB; extrapolates to ~4.5 GB genome-wide, about 30%
on top of the bundle). Can translate any gnomAD rsID,
including variants the bundle itself filtered out.
3    -> safe lower bound for the joint's AC>=5: a variant can
only reach a combined AC of 5 if one callset has at
least 3, since AC_joint is exactly AC_exomes +
AC_genomes (verified on 250,000 records). Loses no
variant the bundle keeps.
5    -> smallest map, but misses variants that clear the
combined threshold without either callset doing so.
